relations: A lower wavy bulge swells and elongates downward, forming a hanging droplet of melted cream.
The protrusion stretches into a thin vertical strand, then necks and pinches off as the drip falls.
After the drip disappears, a faint short line and a small rounded protrusion remain on the lower edge.
The rest of the body, the leftmost bulge, the wooden stick, and the chocolate end remain unchanged.
caption: The video showcases a horizontally held ice-cream bar on a flat wooden stick against a uniform dark background. The cream-colored body, flecked with brown speckles and lit by a glossy highlight on its rounded left tip, stays essentially still, with a chocolate-and-crunch coating marking where the stick enters on the right. Along the lower contour, one of the small wavy bulges slowly swells and elongates downward into a hanging droplet of melted cream. This protrusion stretches into a thin vertical strand with a rounded head, then necks and pinches off, leaving only a faint short line beneath the bar as the drip falls out of view. Afterward the elongated drip is gone and the lower edge again shows a small rounded protrusion at that spot. Meanwhile the leftmost bulge, the rest of the body, the stick, and the chocolate end remain unchanged.
